Privacy policy.

Effective 27 November 2026 · Contact: wetakefwd@gmail.com

Information we collect

When you submit an enquiry, we receive the details you choose to provide, such as your name, email address, business name, project interest and message. Basic technical and usage information may also be collected through hosting, security and analytics tools.

How we use information

We use enquiry information to respond, understand your requirements, prepare a proposal where requested and maintain the security and performance of this website. We do not sell personal information.

Service providers

The website may use providers for hosting, analytics, form delivery and email. They process only the information needed to provide those services under their own security and privacy commitments.

Retention and your choices

We retain enquiry information only while it remains reasonably useful for the conversation, legal obligations or security. You may ask us to correct or delete information by emailing us. We will verify the request before acting.

External links and updates

External websites have their own privacy practices. We may update this notice as the website or the tools it uses change; the effective date above identifies the current version.
